title: Address-component gazetteer
description: Cities, counties, and street-type suffixes used by the Swift AddressComponentsGazetteer to cross-check address candidates. Cities come from the USGS GNIS populated-places extract; counties from the Census 2024 Gazetteer; street types are a curated top-20 list that mirrors the full-word vocabulary in the Swift address regex. All three arrays are sorted for deterministic output.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the shape changes in a way the Swift decoder must observe.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed recorded for reproducibility. Aggregation is not itself randomized; the field is included for uniformity with other Phase 2 artifacts.

sources.description: Provenance records for every raw source folded into this artifact. Each entry carries the SHA-256 of the committed raw file and the retrieval date as documented in SOURCES.md.

id.description: Stable identifier resolving to a row in SOURCES.md.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw source file.

retrieval_date.description: ISO date on which the raw source was fetched.

cities.description: Populated-place feature names from the USGS GNIS national extract. Sorted ascending.

counties.description: County / parish / borough / municipio names from the Census 2024 Gazetteer. Sorted ascending.

street_types.description: Curated street-type suffixes. Fixed-size list that mirrors the full-word vocabulary in the Swift address regex.
